t: A Ligurian port that became one of the great medieval sea powers, with colonies from Chios to Caffa in the Crimea.
It pioneered commercial contracts, marine insurance and the Bank of Saint George, which managed debt, taxes and colonies.
After 1528 an aristocratic republic allied to Spain, its bankers financed the Spanish Empire until c. 1627.
dyk: The Bank of Saint George, a creditors’ bank founded in 1407, governed the island of Corsica on the republic’s behalf for over a century.
ev: Genoese citizens form the compagna communis as their ships join the capture of Jerusalem
Treaty of Nymphaeum with Byzantium opens the Black Sea to Genoese trade
Oberto Doria destroys the Pisan fleet at the Battle of Meloria
Simone Boccanegra is elected the first doge of Genoa
The Peace of Turin ends the War of Chioggia with Venice
The Bank of Saint George is founded to manage the public debt
Andrea Doria allies Genoa with Charles V and reforms its constitution
The republic is replaced by the French-backed Ligurian Republic
